Commentary.Commentary: That's all from the warm up games from our side. The other warm up game between New Zealand and Sri Lanka is turning out to be a thriller. The main event starts on June 1st which will be played on this venue between England and Bangladesh. Good bye and take care.

Indian skipper Virat Kohli says they got what they wanted in both the games. He adds the bowlers did an excellent job in both matches. Also says it is not easy to bat under overcast conditions. Praises Pandya, Jadeja and Jadhav for playing well. Feels that Dinesh Karthik is an outstanding player and hence they gave him a longer run. Adds that they are confident heading into the first game of the Champions Trophy.

Bangladesh skipper Shakib Al Hasan says that his team tried too many things today. Is not too fussed about the bowling but is disappointed about the batting. Does not want this match to ruin their pleasant experiences in the UK recently. He is aware that Bangladesh might get conditions like that of today in the Champions Trophy and wants his side to be prepared for the same.

Earlier in the day, India batted well, with Pandya, Dhawan and Karthik all getting good batting practice. They ended up with 324. Bangladesh bowlers started off well, with Rubel Hossain and Sunzamul Islam being the pick of their bowlers.

Bangladesh could not handle the pace and bounce of the wicket and kept losing wickets. India were excellent with the bat as well as the ball. They will be very confident heading into the Champions Trophy after today's performance. Bangladesh on the other hand will have to do their homework and come out with a better performance in their next game.

So a convincing victory for India. They have bundled Bangladesh out for 84 runs. Their bowling attack used the conditions really well. The pitch quickened up after the first innings and Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Umesh Yadav hit the right lines and lengths. They ran through Bangladesh's top order. Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Umesh Yadav both bagged three wickets each.

OUT! That is a stunner from Dinesh Karthik. Bhuvi is showing his variations as well. After getting a wicket on the short ball, he keeps this on a length, outside off and Mahmudullah goes for the defense from the crease. The foot movement is not of the optimum level and he gets a thick outside edge. The ball threatens to go through the gap between the keeper and first slip but Dinesh Karthik with the gloves dives full stretch to his right and takes it one-handed. Absolutely superb. The ball was dipping as well so it would not have carried to Shikhar Dhawan at first slip. Tremendous keeping. Virat Kohli is all smiles.
